explication: Mem0 is a long-term memory layer for AI assistants and agents, offered as a Python/TypeScript library, platform client, CLI, and self-hosted service. A typical flow submits conversation content and identity scope, extracts and embeds memory, stores it, then searches and returns relevant context. The repository also includes agent integrations and a dashboard for managing a self-hosted service. The README documents additional capabilities such as entity linking, temporal and hybrid retrieval, and hosted-platform features; sampled source confirms only parts of their wiring.
